task.description:
REWORK 1 — Fix design gaps for PLC-01, PLC-02, PLC-03, PLC-04 (Stage 15, MUST/should).

BRANCH: feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815 (commit 8c5b3fc0)

OPEN QUESTIONS — RESOLVED BY ORCH:
1. PLC-01 OQ-2: module_id is GLOBALLY UNIQUE across all tenants. Affects primary key and share-table join.
2. PLC-03 OQ-1: Predecessor = highest ACTIVE version with semver < new (full semver, not same-major-only).
3. PLC-04 OQ-3: YES — grantModuleVisibility and revokeModuleVisibility MUST emit structured audit_log events.

PREVIOUS ISSUES TO FIX:
4. PLC-01-AC-MISSING: SUB_PROCESS with BOTH child_definition_id AND module_ref must be HTTP 422. Add to error taxonomy.
5. PLC-01-PUBLISH-ALREADY-ACTIVE: Add ModuleAlreadyActive variant to ModuleCatalogError enum (HTTP 409 Conflict).
6. PLC-03-OQ-2: null predecessor case (first ACTIVE version) must be explicitly handled — no warnings.
7. PLC-03-OQ-3-ALGORITHM-BUG: optional->required is a breaking change. Update algorithm: if new.required == true AND prev.required in [false, absent] -> breaking.

Update the 4 existing design files. Git add + git commit on feature/WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815.

Return PASS with updated artefact list.
